name: Houmatsu no Yumemonogatari
source: This is a game where, one day out of the blue, the player finds and raises an Asu Cat. The ending changes slightly depending on how you raise it. It features plenty of special graphics and comes with an opening movie!
translation: 在这款游戏中，玩家有一天突然发现并饲养了一只阿苏猫。结局会根据你如何提出而略有不同。它具有大量特殊图形，并配有开场影片！
